# portainer_kubernetes_custom_resources (Data Source)

> **Business Edition only.** This endpoint does not exist in Portainer CE.

Lists the custom resources of one definition.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "portainer_kubernetes_custom_resources" "widgets" {
  endpoint_id = portainer_environment.prod.id
  definition  = "widgets.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `definition` (String) Name of the custom resource definition whose resources are listed, as reported by `portainer_kubernetes_custom_resource_definitions`.
- `endpoint_id` (Number) Identifier of the Kubernetes environment to query.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the resource.
- `resources` (List of Object) The custom resources of that definition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `creation_date` (String)
- `definition_name` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `namespace` (String)
- `uid` (String)

## Attributes Reference

### `resources`

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Name of the resource. |
| `namespace` | string | Namespace of the resource, empty for a cluster-scoped one. |
| `definition_name` | string | Definition the resource belongs to. |
| `uid` | string | Kubernetes UID of the resource. |
| `creation_date` | string | When the resource was created. |
